en.html:
花枝"Just now, between 'more accurately' and 'take aim', I heard something."
Kanae"Couldn't it have been your imagination?"
花枝"God knows it wasn't."
Kanae"How sad. My own sister isn't believing me."
花枝"Fake crying. Disbelief up fifty percent."
Kanae"That apart, won't you take your foot away now? There is no hiding it: rubbing my face on floorboards is not a pleasure I have much taste for."
花枝"Before that, a question."
Kanae"Afterwards will not do?"
花枝"No. Depending on the answer, I break your neck from here."
Kanae"............"
Kanae"What?"
花枝"Was it you who killed Yuhi?"
Kanae"————"
Kanae"Are you asking me that in earnest?"
花枝"............¦ ...¦ Sorry. Just said it."

en.html:
Kanae"Phew. A cruel sister I have. Dust in my hair and everything."
花枝"You know Yuhi is dead."
Kanae"Yes."
花枝"Who did it?"
Kanae"..."
花枝"Looks as if you know."
Kanae"...Won't you leave that matter to me?"
花枝"You mean to settle it by yourself?"
Kanae"............Yes."
花枝"I was his fiancée."
Kanae"Even so."
花枝"............ Will you at least explain afterwards?"
Kanae"Well, now..."
花枝"..."
花枝"Vague words, and the question has been nicely dodged."
Kanae"I am sorry."

花枝"............"
花枝"So. What have you come back for?"
Kanae"My beloved sister's moment of crisis requires an entrance of some distinction. For that."
花枝"...So the entrance was the purpose."
Kanae"I did rescue you on the side, properly."
花枝"What's brought this on?"
Kanae"You find it strange?"
花枝"I do. Before now, you left me alone. No unnecessary helping."
Kanae"I thought that was best. And I had some interest in seeing how you would dispose of that man・・・."
花枝"Then why turn up now?"
Kanae"Looking at the situation."
花枝"The situation? ————Ah. That."
花枝"You intend to kill Shishiku and prevent war with the occupation forces."
Kanae"Very perceptive."
花枝"It would work, certainly. ...If that is your intention, leave it to me."
花枝"I'll keep Shishiku alive another three years."
Kanae"Keep that foreigner's grandchildquarter alive, and unnecessary deaths will keep piling up, you know?"
花枝"But in three years, I can take it all back."
Kanae"All?"
花枝"Ootori. The shogunate. Kanto. Yamato."
花枝"The continent."

en.html:
Kanae"............"
花枝"You doubt it?"
Kanae"If I could doubt you, your elder sister would not have to be quite so nervous."
花枝"Go home today. Shishiku just called the warriors outside back in. Make sure you pass without running into them."
Kanae"That side is taken care of. Sayo is holding the entrance. Until I kill Shishiku, no one is getting through."
花枝"...Were you listening? I'm saying, leave Shishiku to me."
Kanae"Accha. One question."
花枝"What?"
Kanae"You are willing to be married off to His Highness Kuniuji?"
花枝"————"
花枝"...His Highness is not a bad boy."
Kanae"That is the standard line for refusing someone's advances."
花枝"Shut up. Born into a house like Ootori, getting to marry the person you like would be the strange thing."
Kanae"A political marriage is an aristocrat's duty, after all."
花枝"Yes..."
Kanae"But once, one dream did come."
花枝"A dream?"
Kanae"Political, yes. Decided by our parents, yes. Still, my little sister's marriage would be a happy one. She would marry the person she loved..."
Kanae"That sort of dream."

en.html:
花枝"............"
Kanae"Once a person thinks something is hers, and then loses it—only then does the greed become really thorough."
花枝"...What do you want me to do?"
Kanae"Not compromise. Someday, will you kindly arrange a marriage with political approval and love both present?"
花枝"That's asking too much."
Kanae"With all that devious wickedness of yours, it should be simple."
花枝"That is not sounding like a guarantee."
Kanae"Now, for my little sister's future love life. Shall I do the proverbial horse's work and kick the meddling man to death?"
花枝"...And you're all right with that?"
Kanae"With what?"
花枝"Because Shishiku is your—"
Kanae"Yes. For that reason・・・."
Kanae"I want to settle it with my own hands. Forgive me, Hanae. This is the real reason."
Kanae"I do not want to hand that man over to you."
花枝"............"
Kanae"Without a public justification, I intended to bear it. But now I have it, the justificationthis."
Kanae"Killing him now will save many lives in Yamato. And the one who can kill him now is I alone. You cannot."

en.html:
花枝"...Big Sister."
Kanae"So I am no longer leaving it to you. Listen, Hanae."
Kanae"You must not interfere with your elder sister's enjoyment・・・."
花枝"............ From anybody else, I would say: don't go making a clumsy show of consideration."
花枝"Bas. Nothing I can say. This sister is serious・・. Simply that."
Kanae"YES."
花枝"Suppose I have just addressed to you the word meaning 'a person whose mental state is not normal'."
Kanae"From you, that word is quite a blow..."
花枝"You want Father's revenge all to yourself as well?"
Kanae"What belongs to the little sister belongs to the big sister. What belongs to the big sister belongs to the big sister."
花枝"............"
花枝"Shishiku just went out to intercept you. Probably headed for the hall, I think."
Kanae"Why... that is where I came from. At what point did we manage to miss each other?"
Kanae"With that man, it seems I have very little connection."
獅子吼"If only there truly had been no connection. ...Unfortunately, we met long ago."
Kanae"!?"

ja.html:
花枝 「……姉さん」
香奈枝 「だから、あなたに任せるのはやめ。 　いいこと花枝？」
香奈枝 「姉さんの楽しみ・・・を邪魔してはだめよ」
花枝 「…………。 　これがほかの人間の台詞だったら、へたな 気遣いするなって言うとこだけど」
花枝 「なんも言えない。 　この姉は本気・・だ。ただ単に」
香奈枝 「ＹＥＳ」
花枝 「『精神状態が普通ではない人』という意味 の単語をわたしが今あんたに向かって言った と思いなさい」
香奈枝 「あなたに言われるとへこむ単語ねー……」
花枝 「父さんの仇討ちまで独り占めする気？」
香奈枝 「妹のものは姉のもの。 　姉のものは姉のもの」
花枝 「…………」
花枝 「獅子吼はついさっき、あんたを迎え撃ちに 出ていった。 　たぶん、ホールに向かったんだと思う」
香奈枝 「あら……そちらから来ましたのに。 　どこで入れ違いになったのかしら」
香奈枝 「よっぽど縁が無いみたいね、あの男とは」
